brief: a 1940s wooden tabletop valve radio with a fabric speaker grille and two bakelite tuning dials

tickets.title: Model SM_VintageRadio
tickets.instructions: Model a 1940s wooden tabletop valve radio with a fabric speaker grille and two bakelite tuning dials. Real-world size about 40 x 22 x 28 cm. Build it with a bpy recipe script, unwrap UVs, author convex collision hulls, generate 3 LODs, and export FBX.

produces.description: a 1940s wooden tabletop valve radio with a fabric speaker grille and two bakelite tuning dials

tickets.title: Texture T_VintageRadio
tickets.instructions: Author PBR textures for a 1940s wooden tabletop valve radio with a fabric speaker grille and two bakelite tuning dials on the UVs of SM_VintageRadio: bake normal and ambient occlusion from the mesh, then paint base colour, roughness and metallic, channel-packed as ORM.

tickets.title: Sound SFX_RadioStatic and Play_RadioStatic
tickets.instructions: Make warm AM radio static with faint crackle as a seamless loop with a reproducible synthesis script, import it into Wwise, create the event Play_RadioStatic with 3D attenuation, and generate SoundBanks.

produces.description: warm AM radio static with faint crackle

tickets.title: Blueprint BP_VintageRadio
tickets.instructions: Create MI_VintageRadio from the project's master prop material with T_VintageRadio's maps, assign it to SM_VintageRadio, and create BP_VintageRadio (Actor) with a StaticMeshComponent showing SM_VintageRadio and an AkComponent for Play_RadioStatic. Implement BPI_Interactable: toggle Play_RadioStatic on and off each time the player interacts. Place one BP_VintageRadio in /Game/Maps/Apartment at 120, -340, 85.

produces.description: toggle Play_RadioStatic on and off each time the player interacts

tickets.title: Verify BP_VintageRadio
tickets.instructions: Write and run automation tests that spawn BP_VintageRadio, check its collision blocks a player capsule, trigger the interaction and check the expected effect, and check that Play_RadioStatic posts.
